image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a surface. The organism displays a distinct oval shape with a dorsal shell composed of eight overlapping transverse plates (valves). The plates are greenish-grey with mottled patterns and are surrounded by a dark brown, textured girdle. A central longitudinal line of dark spots or markings runs down the middle of the plates.
